title: Nephi Left Alone
summary: A division arises among the people; they scatter, leaving Nephi standing alone among them.

explicit_facts.text: A division arose among the people, who went their separate ways and left Nephi standing in their midst.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The people are visibly moving away from Nephi in different directions.
unspecified_visual_details: The exact place, the people's appearance, and the cause or details of the division.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show why the people divided or depict events preceding this moment.

title: Pondering on the Way Home
summary: Nephi heads toward his house, pondering what the Lord had shown him and grieving the people's wickedness. A voice comes to him.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi went toward his own house, pondering what the Lord had shown him.
As Nephi pondered, cast down because of the people's wickedness, secret works, murders, plunderings, and iniquities, a voice came to him.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi can be shown traveling alone and deep in thought as the voice begins.
unspecified_visual_details: The route, the appearance or source of the voice, and whether the house is visible.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The voice is not identified as visibly appearing in these verses.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the crimes as present action; they are cited as matters Nephi ponders.

title: The Lord Blesses Nephi
summary: The voice blesses Nephi for faithfully declaring the word, seeking God's will, and keeping the commandments. It promises him power and blessing.

explicit_facts.text: The speaker says Nephi has declared the word without weariness or fear, sought God's will, and kept the commandments.
The speaker promises to bless Nephi forever and make him mighty in word, deed, faith, and works.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi is present, listening; the voice may be conveyed off-screen.
unspecified_visual_details: The voice's visible source and any visual manifestation.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The promises are spoken teachings, not events to visualize as miracles occurring here.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict divine or angelic figures; no appearance is described in this moment.

title: Power Declared
summary: The voice identifies itself as God and declares Nephi's power over the people, including power concerning what is sealed or loosed on earth and in heaven.

explicit_facts.text: The speaker identifies himself as God and says Nephi shall have power over the people, including power to smite the earth according to their wickedness.
The speaker grants Nephi power concerning what he seals or looses on earth and in heaven.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi listens to the voice; convey the speech off-screen.
unspecified_visual_details: Any visible appearance of God or angels, despite the speaker's reference to angels.

spoken_dialogue.text: Behold, thou art Nephi, and I am God.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: God

spoken_dialogue.text: whatsoever ye shall seal on earth
spoken_dialogue.speaker: God

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verse describes authority and conditional power, not their exercise in this moment.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show famine, pestilence, destruction, or a visible heavenly assembly.

title: Examples of Nephi's Power
summary: The voice gives examples of what would occur if Nephi commanded the temple to split, the mountain to be cast down, or God to smite the people.

explicit_facts.text: The voice says that if Nephi commanded the temple to be rent in two, it would happen.
The voice says that if Nephi commanded the mountain to be cast down and made smooth, it would happen.
The voice says that if Nephi said God should smite the people, it would happen.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi listens as the voice speaks; the examples can remain off-screen speech.
unspecified_visual_details: The temple and mountain's locations and appearances.

title: Command to Warn the People
summary: The voice commands Nephi to tell the people to repent or be smitten unto destruction.

explicit_facts.text: The speaker commands Nephi to declare that the people must repent or be smitten unto destruction.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi listens to the command; the voice can remain off-screen.
unspecified_visual_details: The voice's visible source and Nephi's exact expression.

spoken_dialogue.speaker: God

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The threatened destruction is conditional and is not shown here.

title: Nephi Returns to the Multitudes
summary: After the Lord speaks to Nephi, Nephi stops, does not go to his house, and returns to the scattered multitudes. He declares the Lord's warning about their destruction if they do not repent. The people harden their hearts and do not heed the Lord's words.

explicit_facts.text: After the Lord speaks to him, Nephi stops and does not go to his house.
Nephi returns to the scattered multitudes and declares the Lord's word concerning their destruction if they do not repent.
Despite Nephi's earlier miracle of telling them about the chief judge's death, the people harden their hearts and do not heed the Lord's words.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi may be shown addressing scattered people who do not appear to heed him.
unspecified_visual_details: The exact location and appearances of Nephi and the multitudes are not specified.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The miracle concerning the chief judge's death is mentioned as a prior event, not an event occurring in this scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the chief judge's death as occurring now.
Do not add dialogue or depict a visible appearance of the Lord.

title: Nephi Repeats the Warning
summary: Nephi declares the warning to repent or be smitten unto destruction. The people refuse to listen, revile against him, and seek to take him to prison.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi declares that the people will be smitten unto destruction unless they repent.
The people harden their hearts, refuse to listen, revile Nephi, and seek to lay hands on him to put him in prison.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi speaks to the people as some move toward him.
unspecified_visual_details: The precise setting and whether anyone physically reaches Nephi.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The threatened destruction is a warning, not a present event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show Nephi being captured or imprisoned; the people seek but fail to take him.

title: Nephi Is Carried Away
summary: As the people try to take Nephi to prison, the power of God is with him, and he is carried away by the Spirit from among them.

explicit_facts.text: The people cannot take Nephi to prison because he is taken by the Spirit and conveyed away from their midst.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi disappears or is borne away from the people, without specifying how this looks.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance, direction, and manner of the Spirit's conveyance.

title: Nephi Declares the Word Among the Multitudes
summary: Nephi goes in the Spirit from multitude to multitude, declaring the word of God until he has declared it to all or sent it among all the people.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi goes forth in the Spirit from multitude to multitude, declaring God's word to all the people.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A single moment may show Nephi addressing one of the multitudes; the text also reports his movement among multiple groups.
unspecified_visual_details: The locations of the multitudes and the visible form of his movement in the Spirit.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: This summarizes repeated preaching; do not combine the separate visits into one simultaneous crowd scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent specific messages or depict every multitude as present together.
